== Summary ==
[[Hayes Hunter]] (left) and [[Brian Fred]] shake hands at the head table before the final game of the [[2020 Endor Grand Prix]] Final Confrontation, 26 January 2020. Full-resolution uncropped original of [[:File:Hayes Hunter and Brian Fred 2020 Endor Grand Prix finals.jpg]].

* '''Event:''' [[2020 Endor Grand Prix]]
* '''Date posted:''' 2020-01-27
* '''Camera date:''' 2020-01-26
* '''Photographer:''' TechTerror (forum handle; the post says he took it)
* '''Identification:''' the post names Hayes and Bfred in the final; the Players Committee wrap-up caption of the cropped version names Hayes Hunter (left) and Brian Fred.

== Source ==
Posted on the Players Committee forum: [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=1286423#p1286423 Congratulations Hayes!!!], post 1286423, by TechTerror, 2020-01-27. Original attachment name: IMG_20200126_181113.jpg (4608×3456); forum attachment id 9927.
* '''Posted by:''' TechTerror
